workload: All sessions and one incident per two sessions. Cold eval/status replies/DOM/layout; complete unchanged and two-row changed refreshes. No caps/culling/pagination.
memoryScope: CDP JSHeapUsedSize after explicit collection, total for this page; not process RSS.

independentReview.reviewer: Separate browser/alert reviewer; dashboard implementation by the coordinating agent
independentReview.sampling: 11 fresh-page samples per variant at each of 100/50, 1000/500 and 2000/1000 sessions/incidents. Baseline/candidate order alternates per sample. Each page measures cold, unchanged and changed refreshes. No failed or slow samples are removed.
independentReview.percentileDefinition: Median for p50; nearest-rank p95 (with 11 samples this is the maximum). These are finite synthetic measurements, not a population latency guarantee.
independentReview.unchangedNodeRetention: Every session and incident node retained on unchanged candidate refreshes in every sample.
independentReview.changedNodeRetention: Exactly one changed session and one changed incident node replaced; every other row remains rendered and retained in every candidate sample.
independentReview.workPreservation: Both variants receive complete structured-cloned state replies, process every session/incident and materialize the complete DOM layout before timing ends. No row limit, pagination, virtualization, viewport culling, transcript truncation, or reduced dataset is used.
independentReview.workShifting: No work is transferred to a worker, delayed background task or later frame to obtain the reported result. Synchronous full-document layout is forced. Browser paint, GPU rasterization and OS window compositing are outside the timing scope for both variants.
independentReview.coldScope: Cold measurement includes script evaluation, complete status-reply cloning, row construction and forced layout in a fresh page. Browser process startup, extension installation, disk/network loads and live account startup are excluded. Cold median is not uniformly faster: the 1000-session candidate is 147.5 ms versus 141.5 ms baseline, with nearly identical p95.
independentReview.runtime: Real isolated headless Chromium with the shipped dashboard JavaScript, HTML and CSS; synthetic metadata and extension APIs. This is not an installed extension or live account acceptance result.
independentReview.hardwareLimits: Shared Linux container/virtualized execution environment. Other team CPU-heavy local jobs were paused during this bounded run. These timings are not measurements of the destination Windows PC, Chrome/Edge/Opera/Firefox installations or physical hardware.
independentReview.memoryLimits: CDP JSHeapUsedSize after explicit garbage collection; not renderer/process RSS, native heap, GPU memory, peak allocation or operating-system footprint. The candidate adds about 54 KB at 100 sessions and 26 KB at 1000 sessions, and uses about 34 KB less at 2000 sessions. Do not claim a universal memory reduction.
independentReview.additionalBehaviorEvidence: Actual Chromium smoke verifies retained keyboard focus across row replacement/reordering, failed-read status retention and action disablement, restoration, inbox triage, and disconnect/reconnect; no page errors at desktop and 390px mobile widths.
